name: Buer Within: AI Growth Coach
subtitle: Find clarity. Take one step.
promotionalText: Make room for what matters. Talk it through, reflect on four areas of life, bring your own story, and turn one insight into a small action you can review.
description:
A little clarity. One conversation away.

Some days, you need space to think before you need an answer. Buer Within is your personal AI growth coach: a calm place to talk through a question, understand your situation and choose one next step. Conversations, guided reflection, personal stories and action reviews work together in your growth profile.

START WITH WHAT MATTERS NOW
Ask about a decision, relationship, work pattern or a feeling you cannot quite name. Suggested questions rotate, or you can write your own. Bring permitted profile context into a conversation when it helps.

REFLECT ACROSS FOUR LIFE DOMAINS
Work through 12 starting questions covering mind, body, connection and meaning, and vocation. Answer one at a time, pause whenever you need and revise what you wrote. When you choose, AI can organize your answers into tentative observations and practical 24-hour, 30-day and 90-day steps.

BRING YOUR OWN STORY
Add turning points, experiences, goals, preferences and real-world constraints over time. Paste text or import TXT and Markdown. Edit or delete each entry, and decide whether AI may reference it. Only a bounded, relevant subset of permitted content accompanies a question when profile context is enabled.

TURN INSIGHT INTO PRACTICE
Choose one small experiment, define what progress would look like and set a review date. Record what happened, then decide what to keep or adjust. Your actions and reflections remain part of your profile rather than disappearing after one conversation.

AN OPTIONAL SELF-KNOWLEDGE LENS
You may also create an on-device Human Design-based reading from birth details and compare its ideas with your lived experience. It is an optional interpretive lens, not a prediction, scientific assessment or definition of your abilities.

YOU CONTROL WHAT YOU SHARE
Your growth profile stays on your device and can be exported or cleared. AI requests are sent to our server and DeepSeek only after consent. Birth details are not automatically attached. Your messages are sent when you request an AI reply. Permitted reflections and stories accompany a conversation only when profile context is enabled.

FREE AND OPTIONAL PLUS MEMBERSHIP
Receive 3 completed AI replies per day, resetting at 00:00 UTC. A completed AI action guide counts as one reply, while failed requests do not use your allowance. Local reflection, stories, readings and action records require no subscription. Optional monthly or annual Plus membership removes the daily AI reply limit; reasonable anti-abuse limits still apply.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel in Apple subscription settings.

The four-domain reflection is inspired by Dan Koe's HUMAN 3.0 framework; it is not an official or validated psychological assessment. AI can make mistakes. Buer Within supports reflection and does not provide medical, psychological, legal or financial advice. You remain the decision-maker.
